title: Kim Hong-yul wins 2nd straight silver in breaking at Asian Games
snippet: TOKONAME, Japan — South Korean B-boy Kim Hong-yul, better known by his stage name Hong 10, won the silver medal in the sport of breaking, or breakdancing, at the 2025 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Saturday. Kim lost to Shigeyuki Nakarai of Japan 3-0 in the final of B-boys breaking at Aichi Sky Expo in Tokoname, just south of Nagoya. He also won silver at the Hangzhou Asian Games in 2023 after losing to Nakarai in the men's breaking final.

title: Seo Chae-hyun wins gold; Lee Do-hyun takes bronze in sport climbing
snippet: NAGOYA, Japan — Sport climber Seo Chae-hyun won the gold medal in the women's lead event at the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Saturday, with fellow South Korean Lee Do-hyun taking home the men's lead bronze medal later in the day. Seo topped the route in the women's lead final at the Port Messe Nagoya Exhibition Hall in Nagoya, central Japan. She edged out Ai Mori of Japan, who scored 47+, for her first career Asian Games gold medal. Seo won bronze in the women's boulder, a problem-solving discipline in climbing, on Thursday, and lead has long been Seo's main event. The 22-year-old proved on Saturday why she is the top Asian in the lead world rankings at No. 2. In lead, the objective for climbers is to ascend as high as possible on a route set on a 15-meter wall within six minutes. Climbers each earn 25 points for reaching and controlling the final top hold of a boulder problem and 10 points for reaching a designated zone hold and making a movement to stabilize or advance the climb.

title: La humanidad recupera la esperanza de vida anterior a la Covid, pero llega con peor salud
snippet: La esperanza de vida mundial está a punto de alcanzar su nivel anterior a la pandemia de Covid-19 . En 2023, la media se situó en 73,3 años, una cifra muy próxima a los 73,4 años a los que se llegaba en 2019, antes de que el coronavirus se expandiera por el globo. Los datos, dados a conocer por la Organización Mundial de la Salud (OMS) , revelan, sin embargo, que vivimos más, pero no necesariamente mejor. La esperanza de vida saludable, es decir, la media de años que las personas mantienen la salud, se está recuperando, pero a menor velocidad. En 2023, llegó a los 62,8 años, lo que supone 0,4 menos que en 2019. Las 'Estimaciones Mundiales de la Salud' de la OMS ofrecen una fotografía de las tendencias en esperanza de vida, causas de muerte y carga de morbilidad en distintos países y regiones entre los años 2000 y 2023. title: Gaza death toll rises after seven Palestinians killed in 24 hours
snippet: Gaza death toll rises after seven Palestinians killed in 24 hours Gaza's death toll has reached 74,229 after seven more Palestinians were killed by Israel in the last 24 hours, the enclave's health ministry reports. The ministry said that seven Palestinians have been killed and 20 others wounded in Israeli attacks in the last 24 hours.
